## VAT and Excise Duty Exemptions:

(a) Excise duty exemption on bank deposits up to BDT 300,000 (previously BDT 100,000).
(b) VAT exemption on the import of Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG).
(c) VAT exemption on the production of tableware and utensils made from leaves, flowers, or bark, handmade clay
utensils, and textile-grade PET chips.
(d) VAT exemption at the trading stage for sanitary napkins, packaged liquid milk, and ballpoint pens.
(e) VAT exemption for computer monitors up to 30 inches (previously 22 inches) at both production and trading
stages.
(f) VAT exemption on lease rent of aircraft used for passenger transport.

## Supplementary Duty Changes:

(a) Supplementary duty on the import of cigarette paper by commercial importers has been increased from 150% to
300%.
(b) A 10% supplementary duty has been imposed on OTT (Over-the-Top) platform services, following the definition
of such services.
(c) Supplementary duty on all types of ice cream has been reduced from 10% to 5%.

# Bangladesh import duty rates 2026: the official numbers, category by category

What import duty do you really pay in Bangladesh? Official NBR FY2024-25 Total Tax Incidence: electronics 37–58.6%, finished clothing 100%+, cosmetics 131–183%, machinery ~26%. All 7,542 tariff lines, searchable.

CIEF Source BD · 31/07/2026

Short answer

Bangladesh taxes imports through a stack of components — Customs Duty, Supplementary Duty, VAT, Advance Income Tax, Regulatory Duty, Advance Tax — that NBR compounds into one figure per product: the Total Tax Incidence (TTI). For FY2024-25, typical TTIs are 37–58.6% for consumer electronics, about 26% for machinery, 100% or more for finished clothing, up to 127.72% for footwear, and 131–183% for cosmetics. The exact rate depends on the 8-digit HS code.

## The number that matters is TTI, not "customs duty"

Ask "what is the import duty on X" and most answers quote the base Customs Duty — often 25%. That is not what you pay. On top of CD sit Supplementary Duty (protective, on goods Bangladesh also manufactures), VAT at 15%, Advance Income Tax, and sometimes Regulatory Duty and Advance Tax. Cosmetics (ch 33)  | 131–183%  | Plus mandatory BSTI clearance

Two patterns explain almost everything:

  1. Inputs cheap, finished goods dear. Raw polymer enters near 10%; finished plastic houseware reaches 127.72%. Essential oils 37%; finished shampoo 183.4%.
  2. Local industry means protection. Bangladesh makes garments, footwear, furniture and tiles — so imports of those carry heavy Supplementary Duty.

## Look up your exact product

Category bands are a guide; duty is set per 8-digit HS code. Our Bangladesh import duty lookup has all 7,542 official tariff lines, searchable in plain English — type "power bank" or "lipstick" and see the full CD/SD/VAT/AIT/RD/AT/TTI breakdown for the exact line.

## If you order through CIEF, you don't compute any of this

These are the rates an importer clearing goods themselves faces. A CIEF order is quoted DDP — delivered duty paid: the product price plus shipping by weight, customs handled on our side. One number, in taka, before you commit. The lookup above is a reference for understanding the market, not a bill you will receive.

## চকোলেট ও সাজসজ্জা উপকরণে গুনতে হবে বাড়তি অর্থ।

Published : 02 Jun 2025, 09:09 PM

Updated : 26 Aug 2026, 12:51 PM

নতুন অর্থবছরে শুল্ক হার বাড়ানোর প্রস্তাব করায় কিছু পণ্য ও সেবার দাম বাড়তে পারে।

সোমবার রাষ্ট্রীয় সম্প্রচার মাধ্যমে ২০২৫-২৬ অর্থবছরের বাজেটে শুল্কহার পরিবর্তনের এ  প্রস্তাব রেখেছেন অর্থ উপদেষ্টা সালেহউদ্দিন আহমেদ। 

মোবাইল ফোন

মোবাইল ফোন উৎপাদন ও সংযোজনের ক্ষেত্রে বিদ্যমান ভ্যাট অব্যাহতি সুবিধা কিছুটা কমিয়ে এর মেয়াদ ২০২৭ সাল পর্যন্ত বাড়ানো হয়েছে। দুই ক্ষেত্রে আড়াই শতাংশ করে ভ্যাট বাড়ানোর প্রস্তাব করা হয়েছে।

সিগারেট

সিগারেট পেপার আমদানির ক্ষেত্রে সম্পূরক শুল্ক হার ১৫০ শতাংশের পরিবর্তে ৩০০ শতাংশের প্রস্তাব রাখা হয়েছে। তামাক বীজ আমদানির ক্ষেত্রে ২৫ শতাংশ শুল্ক আরোপ করা হয়েছে। আগে এই বীজ আমদানিতে কোনো শুল্ক দিতে হতো না। সিগারেটের সম্ভাব্য মুনাফার ওপর ৩ শতাংশের বদলে আরোপ করা হয়েছে ৫ শতাংশ।

চকোলেট ও সাজসজ্জা উপকরণ

চকোলেট এবং সাজগোজের বিভিন্ন উপকরণ শুল্কায়নের ন্যূনতম ‍মূল্য বাড়ানো হয়েছে। যার ফলে এসব পণ্যের দাম কিছুটা বাড়তে পারে। 

সাবান, শ্যাম্পু

ফ্রিজ, এসি

সেট টপ বক্স, কলম

টিভি দেখার সেট টপ বক্স, বলপয়েন্ট কলম এবং কিছু সার্জিকাল পণ্যে আমদানি পর্যায়ের ভ্যাট অব্যাহতি প্রত্যাহার করা হয়েছে। ফলে দাম বাড়তে পারে এসব পণ্যের।

# Which import taxes can you actually recover?

Calculation · about 9 min read · tariff year 2026-2027

The Total Tax Incidence figure on any product page is the full amount you pay at the port. But for a registered business, not all of it is a cost. Some of it comes back, or is set against tax you would owe anyway.

Understanding which parts are recoverable changes how you price goods, and it is the single most common place where importers either overprice themselves out of a deal or underprice and lose money.

## The six taxes, and their nature

Tax  | Full name  | Broad nature
--- | --- | ---
CD  | Customs Duty  | a real, sunk cost
RD  | Regulatory Duty  | a real, sunk cost
SD  | Supplementary Duty  | usually a real cost
VAT  | Value Added Tax  | typically creditable for a registered business
AT  | Advance Tax  | an advance against VAT
AIT  | Advance Income Tax  | an advance against income tax

The word "advance" in AT and AIT is the clue. These are not separate taxes on the goods. They are prepayments of liabilities you have elsewhere, collected at the port because the port is a reliable place to collect.

## Why this matters: the smartphone example

85171300, smartphones, carries a TTI of 64.25%. On an assessable value of BDT 1,000,000:

Component  | Amount (BDT)  | Nature
--- | --- | ---
Customs Duty 25%  | 250,000  | sunk
Regulatory Duty 5%  | 50,000  | sunk
Supplementary Duty 0%  | 0  | —
VAT 15%  | 195,000  | typically creditable
Advance Tax 7.5%  | 97,500  | advance against VAT
Advance Income Tax 5%  | 50,000  | advance against income tax
Total paid at port  | 642,500  | 

You hand over BDT 642,500. But the genuinely sunk portion — CD plus RD — is BDT 300,000. The remaining BDT 342,500 is either creditable against your output VAT or set against your income tax.

So the real duty burden on phones is closer to 30% than 64%, if you are properly registered. An importer who prices at 64% will lose every tender to one who understands this.

## How the split changes across the tariff

The recoverable share is not a constant. It depends entirely on how much of your tax bill is supplementary duty, because SD is sunk and it also inflates the VAT base. Running the full cascade on five representative lines at an assessable value of BDT 1,000,000 shows the pattern:

Goods  | TTI  | Sunk (CD+RD+SD)  | Recoverable  | Recoverable share
--- | --- | --- | --- | ---
84021100 industrial boiler  | 28.73%  | 10,000  | 277,250  | 96.5%
85171300 smartphone  | 64.25%  | 300,000  | 342,500  | 53.3%
61091000 cotton T-shirt  | 104.06%  | 625,000  | 415,625  | 39.9%
33051000 shampoo  | 189.2%  | 1,320,000  | 572,000  | 30.2%
87032431 large reconditioned car  | 1007.5%  | 8,000,000  | 2,075,000  | 20.6%

Read the first and last rows together. The boiler's headline rate is 28.73%, of which 96.5% comes back to a registered importer — the real cost is the 1% customs duty, BDT 10,000. The car's headline rate is 1007.5%, of which only 20.6% comes back. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
